eligibility: Open only if the future immutable temporal_iswas_p7_identity_background_module_leave_one_out_ood_v1 result passes predictions A, C, and E. Bind its exact result SHA in a separate receipt without changing this prior.
question: If complete A11 is stably necessary inside the OOD P7-plus-identity interface, is that contribution localized to the prospectively nominated H3 or distributed across A11 heads?
population: The same immutable OOD FIT/HOLDOUT rows as the P7-plus-identity parent; no row, head, threshold, or union is selected from these outcomes.

fixed_background.identity: Install selected-writer block-10 residual input over the exact causal prefix.
fixed_background.a11_intervention: At A11 c_proj input, replace exact 128-wide selected-writer head slices in an otherwise-native nine-head tensor.
fixed_background.arms: none; all_nine; nine singleton heads H0--H8; nine leave-one-head-out complements.
fixed_background.prospective_head: H3, nominated only from pre-existing original-distribution L11H3 evidence. No OOD head selection is allowed.

measurements.writer_recovery: Each arm's signed recovery against the selected-writer OOD task-margin effect.
measurements.endpoint_attribution: 0.5 * (singleton_increment + leave_one_out_drop); a fixed endpoint attribution, not an exact Shapley value.

predictions.pred_a_conditional_authority_capture_hoo: The future eligibility binding passes; immutable prior/parent authorities match; native/writer captures and every arm's exact entry, six-MLP, and A11 pre-c_proj hooks fire once; exact 22-forward price and finiteness pass.
predictions.pred_b_all_nine_heads_replay_complete_a1: The all-nine head-slice arm reproduces complete A11 and the parent P7-plus-identity reports within 1e-5, and passes the registered full-program geometry bars on both OOD phases.
predictions.pred_c_prospectively_nominated_h3_is_sta: H3 singleton increment, leave-one-out drop, and endpoint attribution are each >=.03 on both OOD phases.
predictions.pred_d_h3_explains_at_least_seventy_perc: H3 endpoint attribution divided by the complete A11 full-minus-none recovery is >=.70 on both OOD phases with the denominator positive.
predictions.pred_e_all_head_arms_preserve_temporal_s: Every none/full/singleton/LOO arm has temporal command-gold collateral <=.01 on both OOD phases.

terminal_rules.awaiting_binding: No eligible immutable module-necessity result has been bound; exit model-free without queue/GPU access.
terminal_rules.invalid_instrument: A or B fails after binding.
terminal_rules.distributed_a11_heads: A/B/E pass and C fails; retain complete A11 as the operational boundary pending a non-native cross-head grouping test.
terminal_rules.h3_plus_distributed_support: A/B/C/E pass and D fails; H3 is necessary but does not dominate complete A11.
terminal_rules.h3_compact_a11_interface: A--E pass; replace complete A11 by H3 in the P7 interface and proceed to joint replay/removal with necessary MLP factors.

tripwires: Before eligibility binding, the runner must exit awaiting_binding without importing/loading a model or touching the queue/GPU.
All-nine pre-c_proj head replacement must replay the complete A11 c_proj output before head outcomes are interpretable.
The none arm leaves A11 fully native/live; singleton and LOO effects are computed relative to none/full in the identical identity-plus-six-MLP background.
No OOD-selected head union, DAS fit, rank choice, threshold tuning, or static weight-norm substitution is allowed.
A passing architectural head is still an operational component up to its internal value/output and rotary-commuting gauges; downstream weight translation remains required.
novelty: Repository search found earlier L11H3 value/routing and head-factor experiments, but none tests all A11 head endpoints inside the newly established exact OOD identity-plus-P7 interface. H3 is nominated prospectively from those earlier original-background results, preventing OOD post-selection.
